sides.note: Wine and its effects: lēṣ hay-yayin hōmeh šēḵār wə-ḵol šōḡeh bô lōʾ yeḥkām (wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler) vs. yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kaʾsan lā laghwun fīhā wa-lā taʾthīm (a cup with no idle talk and no sin). The Quran's heavenly cup lacks just the faults Proverbs gives earthly wine.

The effects of wine. Proverbs: ləmî ʾôy ... ləmî p̄əṣāʿîm ḥinnām ləmî ḥaḵlilûṯ ʿênāyim; la-məʾaḥărîm ʿal hay-yāyin; hikkûnî bal ḥālîtî ... māṯay ʾāqîṣ (woe, wounds, red eyes, stupor). Quran: bi-akwābin wa-abārīqa wa-kaʾsin min maʿīn, lā yuṣaddaʿūna ʿanhā wa-lā yunzifūn (no headache, no loss of wits). The Quran's paradise wine is described by the absence of the drunkard's woes.
